# Owned numeric-record conversion fixture

`workbook-mulrk.xls` is original synthetic Excel16 content generated by
`generate-mulrk-fixture.ps1` and saved as BIFF8 FileFormat56. Row1 has four adjacent
numeric cells10/20/30/40 saved as one MULRK with four distinct XF entries: number
format, bold, fill and italic variations. Row3 contains another four-cell numeric
region. A2/B2 repeat alias text, A4 has a cached SUM formula, and B4 is a NUMBER.
Comment, merged-cell and width anchors are included. No existing source workbook,
macro, link or embedded object is used. Synthetic content is Apache-2.0.

Numeric-to-string tests should cover first/middle/last MULRK entries and NUMBER,
preserving neighboring values/XFs and row-index tables. Native snapshots prove
only captured semantic fields. Cached formula evaluation belongs to the consumer;
the preserving writer does not recalculate. Widths are fixture anchors for format
tests and are not captured by the current native snapshot harness.
